top_issues: "Show 1empty" appears in the BALANCES row header (right side) — reads as a template/lorem leftover, breaking polish and consistency.
The "Instant:" label at bottom left is cut off to "Instant", losing the framing of the send/receive caps.
Three of four legend values (On-chain/Reserve/Secured) are $0.00, so the bar is almost entirely violet "Promised $147.99" — a novice can't distinguish a hub's promise from money they actually hold.
fixes: Replace "Show 1empty" with "Show 1 more".
Render the full "Instant:" label.
Add a plain-language tooltip on "Promised" (with the purple swatch) that says "what a hub owes you on its signature alone".

top_issues: The two route cards differ only by a thin border, so the higher-fee route (H1→H3→H2) is visually weaker despite being a real tradeoff.
"Up to 180.00 instantly" in the Amount field is small and right-aligned, competing with the amount input; the 180/23 caps repeat the Home bar but carry no legend here.
The per-hop fee text ("0.000025 of 0.000050 total") is very small and hard to scan.
fixes: Give the selected route a checkmark + heavier border and a "cheapest"/"faster" tag.
Restyle the per-hop fee as a compact one-line breakdown.
Add a one-line legend that "instant" means inbound credit room, not cash you own.

top_issues: The proof hash prefix reads "6x9838c3d9…b264" — a non-standard "6x" that looks like a typo for "0x", inconsistent with every other hash in the app.
The "Verified by your runtime" claim has no "verify on explorer" path, so the provable story stops inside the app.
The three-button row stretches full width and weights "Done" visually higher than "Copy receipt", the more useful action.
fixes: Show the proof hash with a consistent 0x prefix and copy-on-click.
Add a "Verify on-chain" / explorer link next to the proof.
Make "Copy receipt" primary and demote "Done" to a secondary style.

top_issues: The QR is a large full-white square that visually detaches from the dark layout and would dominate a mobile viewport.
"48.00 capacity via H1" appears twice with no legend — "capacity" is not self-explanatory to a first-timer, and it's really inbound liquidity headroom.
"Note optional / What is this for?" is a generic placeholder with no hint that the link auto-fills amount and note.
fixes: Constrain the QR to a fixed size with a quiet border.
Rename "capacity" to "can receive up to" and add a one-line explanation of inbound room.
Add helper text under Note describing that the payer sees it as a prefilled line.

top_issues: Three different WETH figures coexist (Available 0.000801, Need 0.039191 more, You receive 0.039992) with no single narrative of the shortfall, so a user can't reconcile the swap.
The "100% collateral → 0% collateral" row uses a line with end labels and reads like a slider but is informational only — unclear whether it's actionable.
The order book shows price/size without cumulative depth or a fill marker, so a DeFi user can't judge depth or where a limit fills.
A red "Prepare incoming capacity before swapping" line sits above an enabled-looking blue button; the disabled state isn't visually distinct.
fixes: Present one headline: "have 0.000801 WETH, need 0.039191 more" with a single action.
Make the collateral gauge a real 3-button choice with a visible selected state.
Add cumulative depth and a fill-zone marker to the book.
Give the disabled swap button a clearly different fill and a "why" caption.

top_issues: The WETH lane bar is a few pixels wide (send up to 0.01 / receive up to 0.00) and unreadable at the 1px=$1 scale — the absolute-scale rule deprioritizes tiny balances to invisibility.
The legend (secured/promised/you owe/credit room/in flight) is small text above the lanes, so colors can't be mapped to the bars below without guessing.
The status panel shows "Frames signed 13 / Status Open" but no last-signed timestamp.
fixes: Add a minimum-visible-bar rule or a "magnify tiny lanes" toggle for sub-scale balances.
Make the legend clickable to flash the matching bar segment.
Add a last-signed time to the THIS ACCOUNT panel.

top_issues: Positive and negative amounts use similar green/teal ("+40.00" green vs "-25.00" teal), so the color-as-sign is ambiguous.
The filter chips (All/Payments/Swaps/Settlement/Accounts) carry no counts, so a user can't tell "Settlement" vs "Accounts" contain different event types.
The detail panel largely echoes the list row (to/via/frame), adding little new information.
fixes: Use distinct signed colors or an explicit leading +/− glyph.
Add movement/per-filter counts to the chips.
Make the detail panel add unique fields (route, fee, proof link) instead of echoing the row.

top_issues: This detail screen is visually identical to the activity list (07) with the same right panel — as a "detail" view it adds no new information and reads as a duplicate.
"2 committed entries" is a soft trust signal with no way to open those entries.
There's no obvious back path distinguishing the detail state from the list state.
fixes: Differentiate the detail view with a distinct route/fee/proof section and a "view both committed frames" action.
Add a clear back affordance and per-entry expand.

top_issues: A single long column with ~10 sections and no search or sticky nav — finding Vault or Accent requires scrolling past everything.
Appearance options (Material/Accent/Numbers/Risk color) are stacked with only one static sample card, making options hard to compare.
"Reveal recovery phrase" is shown as plain inline text among settings rather than a gated, destructive-acknowledgment action.
fixes: Add collapsible sections or a left rail.
Render a live preview that updates as each appearance option changes.
Gate "Reveal recovery phrase" behind a warning/confirmation modal.

top_issues: FROM and TO show identical balances (0.00/40.00/155.00) and both selected cards use the same violet border, so source vs destination isn't clear until you read the labels.
The "WHAT HAPPENS" callout explains reserve→account but the "up to 40.00 USDC" cap and the H1 recipient aren't tied to it.
"Add to batch" gives no hint of what a batch is or how many items are pending.
fixes: Distinguish source vs destination (different accent tint + a directional arrow).
Tie the cap and recipient into the WHAT HAPPENS copy.
Add a batch count badge and a one-line definition.

top_issues: The green/violet legend is stated twice (once under totals, once in the explanation sentence), which is redundant.
"H1 hub · 3 lanes 13 frames open" is the only account card and it's small, with no per-lane snapshot.
"NEEDS ATTENTION: Nothing waiting on you" sits in a large empty box that could collapse when there are no items.
fixes: Merge the duplicated legend into one inline key.
Show per-lane mini-bars inside the account card.
Auto-collapse the empty NEEDS ATTENTION panel.

top_issues: "Available 47399024 USDC" is a mis-formatted huge number with no decimal and is inconsistent with "Need 52.000976 USDC more" — the shortfall math and the "100 USDC" amount don't reconcile for a normal reader.
"Depository may pull 0.00" in each token row is cryptic and undefined.
The faucet block has a muted primary "Receive USDC from H1" while a disabled "Accept it as credit instead" sits above stacked ghost buttons, so the real action is visually weak.
fixes: Format availability as "47,399.024 USDC available · 52.001 shortfall" with one explainer.
Replace "may pull" with "depository can draw: 0.00".
Promote the actual faucet claim to a primary button and mark disabled actions with a caption.

top_issues: "100 basis points = 100% per term" is a hard correctness error — 100 bps is 1.00%, not 100%; this destroys trust for any numerate user.
"Offer to the pool" is gray-blue and reads disabled (amount 0.00) with no "enter an amount to enable" hint.
"= 100% per term" uses "term" without defining it as the selected 1 day, so annualization is unclear.
fixes: Change to "100 bps = 1.00% per 1-day term" and show the annualized equivalent.
Disable the CTA with a caption "enter an amount to offer".
Label the term explicitly and show its equivalent.

top_issues: The screen is mostly empty — a single narrow card with a large right void, so it reads as unfinished rather than intentionally minimal.
"Kind: Lazy (hash of its board)" and the quorum prose are dense text mixed into the parameter list.
The right panel "TAKE CONTROL OF ANOTHER ENTITY / Nothing to take over" is a near-empty box.
fixes: Use the space for a live board visualization (signers, threshold, rotation history).
Move the explanatory prose into a collapsible "How a board works" panel.
Give the empty state a call-to-action, e.g. "invite a signer".

top_issues: "Per counterparty" shows "they answer in 1d, you in 1d" as text with no visible dispute-window countdown.
Frame #759 and runtime/signer/entity hashes are repeated across KEYS and LEDGER without linking them.
The dispute path is buried in a breadcrumb ("Manage → Dispute") rather than a direct action.
fixes: Add a visible dispute-window countdown and a "Start dispute" button on the per-counterparty card.
Dedupe the ledger keys and add a single "copy all evidence" action.
Add a direct "Dispute H1" affordance instead of the breadcrumb.

top_issues: Zeros render as a bare "." (e.g., ".") instead of "0.00", which is hard to read and inconsistent with formatted numbers elsewhere.
The "Reserve on-chain" summary row mixes reserve and account state (SECURED 0.00 / PROMISED 122.99 / SEND-RECEIVE 182.99-50.80) and reads as one lane rather than a summary.
The right "RECENT" panel is an empty dark box with no items or empty-state text.
Very high column count with no horizontal-density control or scroll affordance.
fixes: Render zeros as "0.00" consistently.
Separate the summary row from lanes with a divider and a "reserve" badge.
Give RECENT an empty-state message or remove it.
Add a column-density toggle.

top_issues: No recent/quick actions and no fuzzy-match highlight beyond the first row, so the palette feels static for a navigation task.
Right-aligned hints vary in length ("send money" vs "keys, proofs, exposure"), so the hint column misaligns.
A large modal with vertical whitespace for what is a quick-jump action.
fixes: Add recent actions and a highlight as the user types.
Normalize hint width/alignment.
Compact the palette so it feels faster.

overall.verdict: This is a genuinely differentiated dark fintech UI — the absolute bar scale, the enforceable-vs-promised split, and the per-frame proof model give it uncommon trust clarity for power users. It is held back from shipping grade by a handful of hard data errors (100 bps shown as 100%, a mis-formatted 47-million USDC figure) and by depth-first jargon plus a desktop-only layout that gate first-timers and mobile users.
priority_fixes: Fix the math error on 13-lend: "100 basis points = 100% per term" → "100 bps = 1.00% per 1-day term" with the annualized equivalent; this single error undermines trust for Marcus, Dmitri, and Tomasz.
Fix 12-assets data legibility: format "47399024" as "47,399.024 USDC available · 52.001 shortfall" and reconcile it with the "100 USDC" amount; confuses Maya, Anya, and Dmitri.
Fix 01-home polish: replace "Show 1empty" with "Show 1 more" and restore the truncated "Instant:" label — a cheap consistency/trust win for every persona.
Add plain-language progressive disclosure for "promised / collateral / credit room" on Home, Pay, Account, and Swap so novices (Maya, Sofia, Fatima, Lena) are not blocked by protocol terms.

Add an explicit cross-network send flow with a fee breakdown and add a true mobile/compact layout — the current set is desktop-only, leaving Fatima's cross-chain task and Lena's one-handed task unsupported.

personas.name: Maya
personas.verdict: I'd probably get lost in words like "promised", "collateral" and "credit room" before I ever pay my friend $20.
blockers: Home: "Show 1empty" typo and cut-off "Instant:" label look broken; the violet "Promised $147.99" makes most of my balance feel like someone else's promise.
Swap: "Prepare to receive / Accept it as credit instead" and three different WETH numbers are confusing.
Assets: "Available 47399024 USDC" is a huge unexplained number.

personas.name: Tomasz
personas.verdict: The account card shows exactly what I need — credit line vs collateral — but the lending screen's "100 bps = 100%" is a red flag.
blockers: Account (06): WETH lane bar is only a few pixels wide and unreadable at the chosen scale.
Lend (13): "100 basis points = 100% per term" is a genuine math error.

personas.name: Anya
personas.verdict: The book and the 1-bps fee are there, but I'd want real depth and for the collateral gate not to block a simple swap.
blockers: Swap (05): order book has no cumulative depth or fill marker; the three WETH figures (0.000801 / 0.039191 / 0.039992) don't reconcile.
Swap (05): "Prepare incoming capacity" disables the swap button even for an ordinary swap.

personas.name: Ravi
personas.verdict: This is the first wallet that tells me exactly what is enforceable vs promised, and I can export the evidence bundle for the board.
blockers: Sovereignty (15): the dispute path is buried in a "Manage → Dispute" breadcrumb rather than a direct action.
Assets (12) / Desk (16): the zero rendering as "." and the mis-formatted availability hurt the numbers a treasurer must read.

personas.name: Sofia
personas.verdict: I can get a payment link and a clean receipt, but there's no obvious "create an invoice" screen and "promised"/"collateral" scare my clients.
blockers: Receive (04): capacity, not a clear "create invoice" flow; "capacity" wording is unexplained.
Home/Pay: heavy protocol jargon on the top-of-funnel path.

personas.name: Kenji
personas.verdict: The evidence bundle and per-counterparty at-risk numbers are exactly right — though I'd want the dispute window as a visible timer, not text.
blockers: Sovereignty (15): "they answer in 1d, you in 1d" is text only, no live challenge countdown.
Account (06): no last-signed timestamp on the status panel.

personas.name: Lena
personas.verdict: I only see the desktop version — I can't tell if this works one-handed, and there's a lot to tap.
blockers: Only desktop-dark screens are provided; no mobile/compact layout is shown.
Receive (04): the QR is very large and would dominate a phone viewport.
Swap (05): many small dense rows that would be hard to hit on a touchscreen.

personas.name: Marcus
personas.verdict: The desk gives me every lane's exposure and credit lines in one view — exactly what I need, though the lending basis-points math has to be fixed.
blockers: Desk (16): zeros render as ".", the Reserve summary row reads as one lane, and RECENT is empty.
Lend (13): "100 bps = 100%" is a workflow-blocking error when I set rates.

personas.name: Fatima
personas.verdict: I don't see a screen to move USDT from one chain to another — everything looks like one Testnet network, and I need the fee broken out.
blockers: No cross-network send/bridge screen is present; Move (10) only moves within one entity between wallet/reserve/account.
Swap (05) is USDC↔WETH on one network, not USDT across two networks.
Fee is shown for a single route, not as a cross-network cost breakdown.

personas.name: Dmitri
personas.verdict: The absolute-scale bars and the "enforceable vs promised" split are genuinely different — but a "100 bps = 100%" error makes me question the math.
blockers: Lend (13): the basis-points error is visible in a 3-minute skim.
Assets (12): "Available 47399024" reads as a unit or scaling bug.
Jargon density (promised/collateral/credit room) makes the differentiator hard to grasp quickly.
